corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward, Midnight's second deployment and Lava kill artillery before its objective crossing. Maintain a separate artillery damage and projectile record.
Plume damages eastern detention; Steward clears western detention. Midnight's handoff must not introduce an officer within 1.2 of the civilian.
Opening Midnight damages eastern detention; Durin clears western detention. Beagle remains at column 4 to separate detained civilians from blocked officers.
Fang then Spot block the upper central lane; reciprocal opening attacks and western arts remove their queues.
Vanilla then Cardigan block the lower central lane; Durin and shared healing support clearance.
Plume then redeployed Midnight retain upper outer hostiles. Civilian separation takes precedence over the nominal replacement frame.
Opening Midnight then Beagle retain lower outer hostiles through the final wave.

formation_structure.damage_geometry: Western casters face RIGHT, covering their adjacent western roadblocks and nearby ground lanes. Steward, redeployed Midnight and fresh Lava provide overlapping return-flight opportunities.
formation_structure.economic_basis: Fresh deployments through Durin cost 132 DP. Initial DP, natural recovery, Fang's first three grants and Vanilla's first two grants provide 132 by 92 seconds, conditional on survival and successful skill execution. Later spending requires actual recorded income and the observed Midnight redeployment cost.
formation_structure.medical_geometry: Ansel at [5,3] DOWN and Hibiscus at [2,3] UP cover each other, both central tiles and both western caster tiles in their ordinary rectangular ranges. Ansel's extension supplies upper-outer coverage.
formation_structure.opening: Central operators share column 3 and attack across adjacent rows. Lancet-2 covers both before their first sustained engagement.
formation_structure.outer_protection: Plume initially intercepts at column 5; Beagle holds the lower outer lane at column 4. Midnight's later column-3 upper interception is permitted only with explicit civilian separation.
formation_structure.slots: Four ground operators, two healers and two casters use eight slots. The artillery burst exchanges Hibiscus for Lava; every occupied-tile or occupied-slot exchange retreats its predecessor first.

formation_transitions.transition: Lancet-2 establishes opening treatment before the central raiders arrive.
Ansel joins while Lancet-2 remains deployed.
Beagle immediately replaces Midnight in the lower outer lane; start Midnight's actual redeployment cooldown.
Steward begins upper western clearance and shared upper-lane damage.
Hibiscus replaces Lancet-2 and completes reciprocal professional healing.
Exchange Plume for charged-later Midnight only if the upper civilian separation handoff is viable.
Cardigan inherits Vanilla's lower central interception.
Spot inherits Fang's upper central interception.
Exchange Hibiscus for fresh Lava only if both central defenders and Beagle can survive the planned medical absence.
Withdraw Lava only after confirmed artillery death and resolution of its outstanding projectiles.
Restore Hibiscus when her actual cooldown, tile vacancy and DP permit.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Use only the selected catalog operators, each with rarity 1–3 and normal_mode true. Deploy on listed legal terrain with integer [row,col] and cardinal direction.
Never deploy on any of these active-device tiles.
Maintain all four hostile interception duties; no retreat while an uncontained enemy can pass the replacement position.
Execute purchases only against actual DP and deployment capacity. No refund, kill DP, unsupported talent or absent skill grant funds a mandatory purchase.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Do not infer that blocking an officer prevents its attack on a civilian within 1.2.

Before the column-3 Midnight handoff, verify the present upper queue is cleared and western detention will release the civilian before the next officer can enter its attack radius. If this cannot be established, the nominal handoff is forbidden.
Destroy roadblocks through observed ordinary attacks; release is not gated on full hostile clearance. Require safe separation throughout subsequent movement.

The return-flight concentration requires actual skill readiness, surviving attackers and observed target acquisition. Do not count attacks directed at roadblocks or ground enemies as artillery damage.
The 155-second exchange requires enough observed lower-lane HP to survive until treatment returns. No unsupported self-heal is assumed.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active hostiles, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two safe protected-target arrivals. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.decisive_observation: Lancet-2 heals Fang during the first central engagement; both vanguards survive their raiders.
pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Establish four interceptions and immediate central healing.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: A missing treatment or lost interception invalidates the opening and its subsequent income dependencies.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Establish professional healing, replace the lower outer interceptor, and begin both western clearance duties.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: A dead vanguard or failed grant requires reporting a broken survival dependency, not silently retaining later purchases.
pressure_window_responsibilities.survival_dependency: Ansel must actually service central injuries until Hibiscus arrives; Plume must survive without assumed ordinary medical coverage.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Release upper detention, preserve lower detention separation, complete ground replacements and redeploy Midnight.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: If that separation cannot be established, do not execute the nominal handoff; the planned artillery contribution is then unsupported.
pressure_window_responsibilities.handoff_dependency: The column-3 upper handoff requires an empty immediate hostile queue and civilian escape before another officer reaches attack distance.

pressure_window_responsibilities.damage_dependency: Observe at least 13000 effective artillery damage and its death. Range opportunity alone does not establish damage or target selection.
pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Concentrate supported arts attacks on observed artillery opportunities while durable ground operators retain all lanes.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Surviving artillery approaching its objective, caster deaths or protected-target death falsify the clearance hypothesis.
pressure_window_responsibilities.survival_dependency: Ansel must treat actual injuries; lower operators temporarily use their current HP and defense without invented healing.

pressure_window_responsibilities.completion_dependency: Continue beyond the nominal observation horizon if necessary; elapsed time is never completion.
pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Restore healing, clear late officers, paired raiders, armored enemies and residual roadblocks; observe both civilian arrivals.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Any leak or protected-target death rejects project acceptance even if combat otherwise ends.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic +6 grants require survival and deployment. Record actual grants; later grants are never treated as unconditional income.
Activate at 25,55,85,115 seconds only when actually ready. The first 132 DP purchase sequence requires only the first two grants.
Enhancement at 69,164,224,284 seconds. Hold the second activation for the artillery burst; verify treatment of upper Midnight and wounded casters.
Enhance treatment at 110 seconds, then at 250 after successful 220-second redeployment. No passive talent bonus is budgeted.
Hold her ready skill until 112 seconds to improve the last upper-outer engagement before replacement.
Defense at 95,165,235 seconds; each cycle includes its thirty active seconds before forty seconds of recharge.
Second deployment at 125 seconds supplies initial SP; forty inactive seconds permit arts at 165–205. No first-deployment skill or transferred SP is credited.
Deployment at 155 supplies 30 SP; activate at 166 for supported attack speed. Count ordinary modeled hits without splash multiplication.
Use supported attack-SP enhanced hits; neither high-defense priority nor passive ATK is required.
Ordinary modeled attacks only; no self-heal, guardian healing, dodge or unsupported talent credit.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Support the reciprocal central opening immediately with Lancet-2, preserve four interceptions, and fund professional healing before assigning expensive damage duties. Replace prolonged civilian detention with active western-roadblock clearance. Preserve mutually covered medics through establishment, then temporarily exchange Hibiscus for a third artillery attacker during the return flight. This is an unverified candidate; survival, civilian separation, actual income and observed artillery damage are mandatory dependencies.

revised_stage_understanding.current_model: Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Roadblocks detain them; officers can attack them within 1.2. Safe arrival is not a leak. Time-SP pauses during active skills.
revised_stage_understanding.revision: Stationary civilian detention is an exposure that must be actively cleared. Full hostile clearance is not a prerequisite for release when an intercepted, separated route is available.
revised_stage_understanding.timing_status: The return-flight burst and interception windows are diagnostic-model hypotheses informed by source routes and the prior artillery leak at frame 5759; they are not exact client timing.

falsifiers: No early Lancet-2 treatment of Fang.
An opening interceptor dies or a hostile passes its responsibility.
Upper detention cannot release safely before the column-3 handoff becomes exposed.
Artillery remains alive at its objective approach.
Either civilian dies or fails to arrive safely.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.hypothesis: Immediate Lancet-2 treatment and reciprocal central damage can preserve the opening long enough to establish funded professional healing. Active western clearance can remove civilians from dangerous detention, permitting a charged Midnight handoff and a three-attacker return-flight artillery kill.

revised_tactical_requirements.acceptance: Positive remaining life, zero leaks, zero protected-target deaths, two safe arrivals, exhausted spawns and no active hostiles.
revised_tactical_requirements.clearance: Observe artillery death before its objective crossing, resolve projectiles, then finish all remaining hostiles.
revised_tactical_requirements.economy: Treat missing grants as failed survival or skill dependencies. Later actions do not repair an earlier collapse.
revised_tactical_requirements.handoffs: Every retreat requires an affordable, ready replacement and containment through the exchange.
revised_tactical_requirements.opening: Demonstrate immediate central treatment and survival before relying on later income.
revised_tactical_requirements.protection: Maintain officer separation during detention and movement; verify two actual safe arrivals.
revised_tactical_requirements.verification_status: Unverified OperationalPlan; no stage simulation was run.

changed_responsibilities: Lancet-2 owns first-engagement central treatment instead of waiting for Ansel.
Beagle inherits lower outer interception early so Midnight can complete a real cooldown and recharge for the return flight.
Western casters own civilian release during combat instead of waiting for full hostile clearance.
The upper Midnight handoff depends on observed civilian separation rather than block count alone.
Hibiscus temporarily yields her slot to fresh Lava only after durable ground replacements and an explicit survival gate.
revision_hypothesis.if_expected_event_absent: Mark the immediate-support hypothesis falsified and inspect actual range, injury eligibility, treatment selection and first-engagement survival. Do not assume later healing, income or replacements can recover the missing opening duty; report the broken dependency without running an unrequested simulation.
revision_hypothesis.tactical_hypothesis: Replacing delayed opening support with immediate ordinary healing, preserving separate interception duties and clearing civilian detention before the artillery return may prevent the verified early collapse and create a viable concentrated clearance window.
